# Browser bundle

`gleaph-sdk.mjs` is generated by `scripts/build-browser-sdk.mjs` from
`sdk/client/js/dist/index.mjs` and its browser dependencies. It exists so
`similar-films.html` can run from a static server without a repository-root import map or
`node_modules` at page runtime.

Do not edit it by hand. Rebuild after changing the JS SDK:

```bash
cd demo/movies
node scripts/build-browser-sdk.mjs
```

The bundle is minified ESM and contains no embedding model or model assets. The SDK itself remains
model-free; see `sdk/client/js/README.md`.
